data.description:
I'm a software engineer who enjoys building reliable, maintainable software with modern JavaScript frameworks. I care about writing clean code, making thoughtful design decisions, and building systems that are easy to understand and improve as they grow.

I also have hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, and evaluating model responses. More recently, I've been using AI-assisted tools like Claude Code to speed up development, explore solutions, refactor code, and write meaningful tests while keeping code quality a priority.

I'm naturally curious, enjoy tackling challenging problems, and like learning new tools and technologies. I work well with others, take ownership of my work, and always look for ways to build better software.
